articles.summary: Following the compliance plan submitted to the Nasdaq Hearing Panel, the Company has received confirmation from Nasdaq that it has regained compliance with the continued listing requirements set forth in Nasdaq Listing Rules 5550(b) (the “MVLS Rule”) and 5550(a)(2) (the “Bid Price Rule”), and will continue being listed on The Nasdaq Capital Market.
articles.title: Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc. Announces Compliance with Nasdaq Continued Listing Requirements

articles.summary: The action seeks attorneys’ fees, costs, and damages against multiple parties related to the December 2024 involuntary bankruptcy filed against Mawson (the “Involuntary Petition”), which was dismissed with prejudice by written order on November 4, 2025.
articles.title: Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc. Files Adversary Complaint Seeking Damages for Bad-Faith Bankruptcy Filing

articles.summary: Mawson's Interim CEO, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary Kaliste Saloom and CFO Bill Regan will present at the Emerging Growth Conference on Thursday, December 11, 2025, at 1:10 PM Eastern Time.
articles.title: Mawson Infrastructure to Present at Emerging Growth Conference on December 11, 2025
